sentence: This project tries to find out how extracellular vesicles, which let cells communicate, play a role in Alzheimer's Disease.
This project studies how a protein that regulates genes controls the growth and function of cardiomyocytes.
This project studies how Notch receptors pick their partner proteins and builds proteins that adjust the activity of Notch proteins.
This project studies the genes behind malformations of the oral cavity, using human fetal tissue and spatial transcriptomics.
This project studies why cancers resist drugs that target RNA polymerase I by changing how they make proteins.
This project studies how neutrophils and tumor genes affect how cancer starts and grows.
This project studies which proteins interact with a nuclear receptor in T helper 17 cells that drive inflammatory bowel diseases.
This project tries to find out why some subtypes of leukemia resist drugs that degrade a nuclear protein.
This project maintains a database of mouse gene expression data and keeps its computer systems running.
This project builds computational tools that use single-cell measurements to study how cell fate changes go wrong in clonal hematopoiesis.
This project builds a computational framework for analyzing the large datasets produced by multiplex assays of variant effect.
This project studies a rare group of tumor cells in glioblastoma and how their signaling in the tumor microenvironment may cause treatment resistance.
This project looks for somatic mutations that cause epilepsy and brain malformations and how they affect normal brain development.
This project examines the role of glycosphingolipids, a class of membrane lipids abundant in the brain, in Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds deep learning models that detect prostate cancer on MRI more reliably under different imaging conditions.
This project holds meetings on human genetic ancestry and how it affects disease risk in Africa and the US.
This project studies how T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells use an inflammation pathway to spread into the meninges.
This project studies how missense mutations in an acetyltransferase help B cell lymphoma develop.
